description: Source-faithful affine projection of equilateral spatial triangle ABC and perpendicular MN for exercise 336. N stays at the upper endpoint, M at the lower endpoint inside the projected triangle, with an unmarked MN/AC crossing and no solution constructions.

authoritativeText.text: **定理21. 平面内的一条直线垂直于平面的斜线的充分和必要条件是这条直线垂直于斜线的射影.**

证明. 我们研究下列三条直线：
$(AC)$是平面$\alpha$的垂线，$(AB)$ 是斜线，$(CB)$是斜线在平面$\alpha$上的射影(图131).

充分性. 设直线$m$在平面$\alpha$内且垂直于$(CB)$.
这样，直线$m$垂直于平面$ABC$内的直线$(CB)$和$(AC)$.
于是，$m\perp(ABC)$(§28，定理14)，因此$m\perp(AB)$.

必要性. 设$m\subset\alpha$，$m\perp(AB)$.
因为还有$(AC)\perp m$，所以$m\perp(ABC)$，因此，$m\perp(CB)$. $\blacksquare$
336. 如图134，三角形$ABC$表示正三角形，线段$MN$表示过点$N$垂直于三角形所在平面的垂线. 求作过点$M$、$N$且垂直于三角形各边的垂线.

inventory.description: One unframed triangle and one normal segment; five labels A, B, C, M, N. No caption, dimensions, ticks, axes, grid, arrowheads or right-angle marks. Triangle A is left on the bottom, B right on the bottom, C upper-right of the base midpoint. AB is horizontal in projection. AB, BC, CA are solid. The normal segment has N at its upper endpoint and M at its lower endpoint. N is above C and M's projected point is inside the triangle below AC, above AB, and left of C. MN is vertical and solid. It crosses AC between A and C in projection, without a labelled or independently marked crossing. It stops at M, not at AB. N and M have visible filled endpoint dots. A, B and C are plain stroke junctions without additional dot disks. N label is above N; M to the right and slightly below M; A below-left; B below-right; C above C. The triangle represents a spatial equilateral triangle. Projected unequal screen lengths are not its spatial metric. The normal through N need not point upward on the page and N need not lie within the triangle itself. Modern regularization: Straighten scan strokes and the nearly vertical MN while preserving N at the upper endpoint, M at the lower endpoint and the unmarked AC crossing. Use a true equilateral triangle in a separate spatial model with its source-faithful affine projection, not a planar equilateral replacement. No learner-requested perpendicular constructions, foot labels, right-angle marks, dimensions, solutions or extra segments will be added. Spatial metric claims are checked by sibling spatial-model.json and spatial-check.mjs; 2D assertions check affine incidence, endpoint attachment and directions only.
